prompt: Complete StreamJoin: initials joins the uppercased first letters of the non-blank names with dots (e.g. "A.G.L"), and countDistinctWords counts case-insensitive distinct whitespace-separated words.
explanation: initials chains filter, map, and Collectors.joining: joining inserts the dot separator only BETWEEN elements, so one initial gets no dots and an empty stream yields the empty string. countDistinctWords normalizes case with toLowerCase before distinct(), so THE and the collapse into one word; trimming first and filtering empty strings handles the blank-sentence edge case, where split would otherwise report a single empty word.
hints: For initials, filter out blank names first (String has an isBlank method), then map each survivor to a one-character String.
Collectors.joining(".") puts the separator only between elements and produces "" for an empty stream.
For counting, split on the regex \s+, lowercase every word, then distinct().count(). Watch out: splitting a blank sentence can produce one empty string.
